brief:
Drop Site News aired human rights lawyer Diana Buttu in conversation with host Sharif Abdel Kouddous about Gaza negotiations. The segment examined the status of talks and related developments in the region. The broadcast then shifted to coverage of Florida's primary elections, with correspondent Julian Andreone interviewing candidates Elijah Manley and Oliver Larkin about their campaigns and positions.

The program also devoted time to the case of Maryam Tahmasebi, who remains in Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention. Legal representatives for Tahmasebi appeared on air to discuss her situation and the circumstances surrounding her custody. The segment provided a platform for her lawyers to present her case to viewers.
dek: Human rights lawyer Diana Buttu joins Sharif Abdel Kouddous, followed by Julian Andreone with FL primary candidates: Elijah Manley & Oliver Larkin, then lawyers for Maryam Tahmasebi in ICE detention.
title: Buttu discusses Gaza talks on Drop Site News broadcast
